decision_rationale: EVENT_A generates consistent, reproducible counter-regime excursion (mean 0.81 ATR MFE vs 0.22 ATR MAE to flip, 74.8% positive net return) with robust continuation after the flip (+0.65 ATR MFE at 180s), exhibiting a mixed scalp and early-reversal structure. EVENT_B generates statistical survival (38.2% reach NEW_MAX) but weak forward expansion (mean remaining MFE only 0.44 ATR, 61.8% survive without meaningful re-extension), failing to justify an add-on policy.
